Design & checks

A one-piece perforated cage uses the full 148 mm deck radius. Peaked wall windows, sloped perimeter flanges and a 6 mm solid mounting plate replace the boxed support, front frame and both external struts. Wide side ports clear radial travel. Two broad perforated rear webs join the grid directly to the rear cage; the clipped column remnants are removed.

Reuse the ring, deck, base and lightened stand. All ten cage foot screws are M4×12. The 23-part print kit includes an upright cage; review local window and flange support in your slicer. Z is blue-gray; radial is terracotta.

The upright layer audit finds no large unsupported regions; short hole bridges remain. Comparative FEA improves rear-directed bending, while radial stiffness remains a limitation. Absolute FEA results are mesh-sensitive and do not establish physical strength or probing accuracy.
